                the current one has spaces in it. 
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
1.INITIAL ENVIRONMENT SETTINGS:

!!!! MAKE SURE YOUR HOME DIRECTORY PATH DOES NOT CONTAIN ANY SPACES
!!!! 
!!!! IF IT DOES, REPLACE [USERNAMEWITHOUTSPACES] IN THE FOLLOWING 
!!!! 
!!!! COMMAND THEN EXECUTE.
!!!!
!!!! bash$ cp /etc/passwd /etc/passwd_old ; sed -e s%"$(whoami)"%[USERNAMEWITHOUTSPACES]%g /etc/passwd > /etc/temp ; mv /etc/temp /etc/passwd
!!!!

#### cygwin1.dll version: 1.3.12
#### gcc version: 2.95.3-5 (cygwin special)
#### uname output: CYGWIN_NT-5.0

bash$ export target=mipsel-linux
bash$ export host=$MACHTYPE
bash$ export build=$MACHTYPE
bash$ export prefix=~/toolchains/xLinux4BE
bash$ export archive=~/Linux4BE_SDK_20020808/pkgs
bash$ export MAKE_MODE=UNIX


~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
2.GETTING THE SOURCES:

#### NOTE: If you are using the SDK and have already downloaded the  
#### toolchain packages to the <sdk_path>/pkgs directory, this step
#### can be skipped. In which case you should set the following
#### environment variable to match the packages you have. Default
#### values are given.
#### 
####    bash$ export binutils_version=2.12
####    bash$ export gcc_version=3.0.4
####    bash$ export glibc_version=2.2.4 (Linux Platforms Only)
####    bash$ export sf_version=2.4.18
####    bash$ export linux4be_version=20021129
####

bash$ mkdir -p $archive
bash$ cd $archive

#### Login into CVS tree at http://www.linux4.be to get 
#### the latest linux4BE kernel modifications. Press "Return" 
#### when prompted for password. You only need to do this once on any 
#### machine. To avoid name conflict, rename linux directory to 
#### linux4be-$linux4be_version, Then pack it up for storage.

bash$ linux4be_version=20021129
bash$ cvs -d:pserver:anonymous@cvs.linux4.be:/cvsroot login 
bash$ cvs -z3 -d:pserver:anonymous@cvs.linux4.be:/cvsroot co linux/kernel 
bash$ mv linux linux4BE-$linux4be_version
bash$ cd linux4be-$linux4be_version/kernel; tar -zcpf ../../linux4be-$linux4be_version.tar.gz .; cd ../..


#### Login into CVS tree at http://linux-mips.sourceforge.net to get 
#### the linux-mips modifications for the linux kernel. Press "Return" 
#### when prompted for password. You only need to do this once on any 
#### machine. Also note that this may not be the lastest as indicated
#### by the [-D "12-nov-2002"] option to cvs. 

bash$ cvs -z3 -d:pserver:anonymous@cvs.linux-mips.sourceforge.net:/cvsroot/linux-mips co -D "12-nov-2002" linux

#### Take a look of ./linux/Makefile and determine the kernel version to 
#### download. To avoid name conflict, rename linux directory to 
#### sf-linux-$sf_version, Then pack it up for storage.

bash$ version=$(grep ^VERSION\ *=\ * ./linux/Makefile | sed -e s%VERSION\ *=\ *%%)
bash$ patchlevel=$(grep ^PATCHLEVEL\ *=\ * ./linux/Makefile | sed -e s%PATCHLEVEL\ *=\ *%%)
bash$ sublevel=$(grep ^SUBLEVEL\ *=\ * ./linux/Makefile | sed -e s%SUBLEVEL\ *=\ *%%)

bash$ export sf_version=$version.$patchlevel.$sublevel

bash$ mv linux sf-linux-$sf_version
bash$ cd sf-linux-$sf_version; tar -zcpf ../sf-linux-$sf_version.tar.gz .; cd ..

#### Goto http://www.kernel.org/pub/linux/kernel/ to grab the right
#### version of kernel source.

bash$ wget -P$archive http://www.kernel.org/pub/linux/kernel/v$version.$patchlevel/linux-$sf_version.tar.gz

#### Goto ftp://ftp.gnu.org and get copies of binutils and gcc.

bash$ export binutils_version=2.12
bash$ export gcc_version=3.0.4

bash$ wget -P$archive ftp://ftp.gnu.org/gnu/binutils/binutils-$binutils_version.tar.gz
bash$ wget -P$archive ftp://ftp.gnu.org/gnu/gcc/gcc-$gcc_version/gcc-$gcc_version.tar.gz 

vvvv (Linux Platforms Only)

#### Goto ftp://ftp.gnu.org and get a copy of glibc including linuxthreads.

bash$ export glibc_version=2.2.4
bash$ wget -P$archive ftp://ftp.gnu.org/gnu/glibc/glibc-$glibc_version.tar.gz 
bash$ wget -P$archive ftp://ftp.gnu.org/gnu/glibc/glibc-linuxthreads-$glibc_version.tar.gz

^^^^ (Linux Platforms Only)

#### Get a default kernel ramdisk image to play with.

bash$ wget -P$archive http://www.linux4.be/download/ramdisk/ramdisk.gz

vvvv (Win32/Cygwin Platforms Only)

#### Get the linux4be target runtime
bash$ wget -P$archive http://www.linux4.be/~jal0/linux4be-runtime-$sf_version-$linux4be_version.tar.gz

^^^^ (Win32/Cygwin Platforms Only)

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
3.INSTALLING THE SOURCES:


bash$ mkdir -p $prefix/build
bash$ cd $prefix/build

vvvv (Linux Platforms Only)

#### Install the Linux Kernel Sources

bash$ tar -xzf $archive/linux-$sf_version.tar.gz
bash$ cd $prefix/build/linux

^^^^ (Linux Platforms Only)

#### Install the stock kernel Sources

bash$ tar -xzf $archive/linux-$sf_version.tar.gz

#### Install the mipsel-linux kernel Sources

bash$ cd linux; tar -xzf $archive/sf-linux-$sf_version.tar.gz; cd ..

#### Install the linux4BE kernel Sources

bash$ cd linux; tar -xzf $archive/linux4be-$linux4be_version.tar.gz; cd ..

#### Install binutils Sources

bash$ tar -xzf $archive/binutils-$binutils_version.tar.gz

#### Install gcc Sources

bash$ tar -xzf $archive/gcc-$gcc_version.tar.gz

vvvv (Linux Platforms Only)

#### Install libc sources

bash$ tar -xzf $archive/glibc-$glibc_version.tar.gz
bash$ cd glibc-$glibc_version 
bash$ tar -xzf $archive/glibc-linuxthreads-$glibc_version.tar.gz 

^^^^ (Linux Platforms Only)

vvvv (Win32/Cygwin Platforms Only)

#### Unpack Linux4BE Runtime package

bash$ tar -xzf $archive/linux4be-runtime-$sf_version-$linux4be_version.tar.gz

#### Fix shared library libc.so
echo "GROUP ( libc.so.6 libc_nonshared.a )" > linux4be-runtime-$sf_version-$linux4be_version/lib/libc.so

^^^^ (Win32/Cygwin Platforms Only)

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
4.BUILD CROSS-BINUTILS:

bash$ mkdir bld-binutils-$binutils_version
bash$ cd bld-binutils-$binutils_version

bash$ ../binutils-$binutils_version/configure \
            --target=$target \
            --prefix=$prefix \
            2>&1 | tee ../binutils-configure.log
		  
bash$ make 2>&1 | tee ../binutils-build.log
bash$ make install 2>&1 | tee ../binutils-install.log
bash$ cd .. 

#### add to path so cross-binutils can be found

bash$ export PATH=$prefix/bin:$PATH

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
5.CONFIGURE THE KERNEL SOURCES:

#### Firts packagae up the sources in case you want to start over later.

bash$ mv linux linux4be-$sf_version-$linux4be_version
bash$ tar -zcpf $archive/linux4be-$sf_version-$linux4be_version.tar.gz linux4be-$sf_version-$linux4be_version
		
bash$ cd linux4be-$sf_version-$linux4be_version

bash$ make CROSS_COMPILE=$target- mrproper
bash$ cp config_be300 .config

#### configure linux for device

bash$ make CROSS_COMPILE=$target- oldconfig
bash$ make CROSS_COMPILE=$target- dep 2>&1 | tee ../kernel-dep.log

#### create kernel source simlinks

bash$ cd $prefix/$target
bash$ mkdir include 
bash$ cd include 
bash$ ln -s $prefix/build/linux4be-$sf_version-$linux4be_version/include/asm-mips asm 
bash$ ln -s $prefix/build/linux4be-$sf_version-$linux4be_version/include/linux linux

bash$ cd $prefix/build

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
6.BUILD GCC 'C' BOOTSTRAP CROSS-COMPILER:  (Linux Platforms Only)

#### build & install the bootstap compiler

bash$ mkdir bld-gcc_s1-$gcc_version
bash$ cd bld-gcc_s1-$gcc_version

bash$ ../gcc-$gcc_version/configure \
            --target=$target \
            --prefix=$prefix \
            --with-gnu-as \
            --with-gnu-ld \
            --with-as=$prefix/bin/$target-as \
            --with-ld=$prefix/bin/$target-ld \
            --with-newlib \
            --disable-shared \
            2>&1 | tee ../gcc_s1-configure.log
            
bash$ make SUBDIRS="libiberty texinfo gcc" \
            ALL_TARGET_MODULES= \
            CONFIGURE_TARGET_MODULES= \
            INSTALL_TARGET_MODULES= \
            LANGUAGES="c" \
            2>&1 | tee ../gcc_s1-build.log
            
bash$ make SUBDIRS="libiberty texinfo gcc" \
            INSTALL_TARGET_MODULES= \
            LANGUAGES="c" install \
            2>&1 | tee ../gcc_s1-install.log
            
bash$ cd ..

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
7.BUILDING THE GLIBC RUNTIME LIBRARY:  (Linux Platforms Only)

#### configure & install

bash$ cd $prefix/build
bash$ mkdir glibc-build
bash$ cd glibc-build

bash$ CC=$target-gcc CC=$target-gcc \
            BUILD_CC=gcc \
            AR=$target-ar \
            RANLIB=$target-ranlib \
            ../glibc-$glibc_version/configure \
            --prefix=$prefix/$target \
            --host=$target \
            --enable-add-ons=linuxthreads \
            --disable-sanity-checks \
            2>&1 | tee ../glibc-configure.log

#### sitback, this may take a while!

bash$ make 2>&1 | tee ../glibc-build.log

#### install

bash$ make install 2>&1 | tee ../glibc-install.log

#### fix library for packaging up

bash$ echo "GROUP ( libc.so.6 libc_nonshared.a )" > $prefix/$target/lib/libc.so
bash$ cd ..

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
8.BUILD GCC 'C/C++' 2nd-Stage CROSS-COMPILER:  (Linux Platforms Only)

bash$ mkdir bld-gcc_s1-$gcc_version
bash$ cd bld-gcc_s1-$gcc_version

bash$ ../gcc-$gcc_version/configure \
            --target=$target \
            --prefix=$prefix \
            --with-gnu-as \
            --with-gnu-ld \
            --with-as=$prefix/bin/$target-as \
            --with-ld=$prefix/bin/$target-ld \
            --enable-languages=c,c++ \
            --enable-shared \
            --enable-threads \
            2>&1 | tee ../gcc_s2-configure.log

bash$ make 2>&1 | tee ../gcc_s2-build.log
bash$ install 2>&1 | tee ../gcc_s2-install.log

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

9.BUILD GCC 'C/C++' CROSS-COMPILER:  (Win32/Cygwin Platforms Only)

bash$ mkdir bld-gcc-$gcc_version
bash$ cd bld-gcc-$gcc_version

bash$ ../gcc-$gcc_version/configure \
            --target=$target \
            --host=$host \
            --prefix=$prefix \
            --enable-languages=c,c++ \
            --enable-shared \
            --enable-threads \
            --with-headers=$prefix/build/linux4be-runtime-$sf_version-$linux4be_version/include \
            --with-libs=$prefix/build/linux4be-runtime-$sf_version-$linux4be_version/lib \
            2>&1 | tee ../gcc-configure.log

bash$ make 2>&1 | tee ../gcc-build.log
bash$ install 2>&1 | tee ../gcc-install.log
bash$ cd ..


#### Remove .exe extensions from cross-compiled target binaries
bash$ cd $prefix/$target/bin
bash$ for i in $(find . -name '*.exe' -printf %p\ ) ; do mv -f $i $(echo $i | sed -e s%.exe%%) ; done 


~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

10.FINAL STEP

#### Now fix cross toolchain includes
bash$ cd $prefix/$target
bash$ rm -fr include
bash$ mv ./sys-include ./include
bash$ ln -s ./include ./sys-include

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
                  !!!!!!!!!! ALL DONE !!!!!!!!!!

!!!! BELOW ARE SOME OTHER THING THAT MAY BE USEFULE

########
#### Packaging up the runtime environment for later use
####
#### If not already set,
####
####     bash$ export $prefix=~/toolchains/xLinux4BE
####     bash$ export $target=mipsel-linux
####     bash$ export $sf_version=2.4.18
####     bash$ export $linux4be_version=20021129
####

bash$ cd $prefix
bash$ ln -s ./$target ./linux4be-runtime-$sf_version-$linux4be_version

bash$ tar -zcpf $archive/linux4be-runtime-"$sf_version"-"$linux4be_version"_new.tar.gz \
                 ./linux4be-runtime-$sf_version-$linux4be_version/include \
                 ./linux4be-runtime-$sf_version-$linux4be_version/lib

bash$ rm -f ./linux4be-runtime-$sf_version-$linux4be_version

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

########
#### Packaging up the entire cross-toolchain binaries
####   This assums the cross-tools are located at ~/toolchain/xLinux4BE
####
#### If not already set,
####
####     bash$ export $prefix=~/toolchains/xLinux4BE
####     bash$ export $sf_version=2.4.18
####     bash$ export $linux4be_version=20021129
####

bash$ cd ~

bash$ ln -s ./toolchains/xLinux4BE ./linux4be-tools-win32-"$sf_version"-"$linux4be_version"
                                 !!!! OR !!!!
bash$ ln -s ./toolchains/xLinux4BE ./linux4be-tools-linux-"$sf_version"-"$linux4be_version"


bash$ tar -zcpf $archive/linux4be-tools-win32-"$sf_version"-"$linux4be_version"_new.tar.gz \
                 ./linux4be-tools-win32-"$sf_version"-"$linux4be_version"/bin \
                 ./linux4be-tools-win32-"$sf_version"-"$linux4be_version"/include \
                 ./linux4be-tools-win32-"$sf_version"-"$linux4be_version"/info \
                 ./linux4be-tools-win32-"$sf_version"-"$linux4be_version"/lib \
                 ./linux4be-tools-win32-"$sf_version"-"$linux4be_version"/man \
                 ./linux4be-tools-win32-"$sf_version"-"$linux4be_version"/mipsel-linux \
                 ./linux4be-tools-win32-"$sf_version"-"$linux4be_version"/share
                                 !!!! OR !!!!
bash$ tar -zcpf $archive/linux4be-tools-linux-"$sf_version"-"$linux4be_version"_new.tar.gz \
                 ./linux4be-tools-linux-"$sf_version"-"$linux4be_version"/bin \
                 ./linux4be-tools-linux-"$sf_version"-"$linux4be_version"/include \
                 ./linux4be-tools-linux-"$sf_version"-"$linux4be_version"/info \
                 ./linux4be-tools-linux-"$sf_version"-"$linux4be_version"/lib \
                 ./linux4be-tools-linux-"$sf_version"-"$linux4be_version"/man \
                 ./linux4be-tools-linux-"$sf_version"-"$linux4be_version"/mipsel-linux \
                 ./linux4be-tools-linux-"$sf_version"-"$linux4be_version"/share

bash$ rm -f ./linux4be-tools-win32-"$sf_version"-"$linux4be_version"
                                 !!!! OR !!!!
bash$ rm -f ./linux4be-tools-linux-"$sf_version"-"$linux4be_version"

########
#### Installing cross-toolchain binaries
####   This assums the cross-tools will be installed at ~/toolchain/xLinux4BE
####   and the cross-tools package is located at ~/$sdk_root
####
#### If not already set,
####
####     bash$ export $sdk_root=~/linux4be_sdk_20021129
####     bash$ export $sf_version=2.4.18
####     bash$ export $linux4be_version=20021129
####

bash$ mkdir -p ~/toolchains
bash$ cd ~/toolchains

bash$ tar -xzf $sdk_root/linux4be-tools-win32-"$sf_version"-"$linux4be_version".tar.gz
bash$ mv linux4be-tools-win32-"$sf_version"-"$linux4be_version" xLinux4BE
                                 !!!! OR !!!!
bash$ tar -xzf $sdk_root/linux4be-tools-linux-"$sf_version"-"$linux4be_version".tar.gz
bash$ mv linux4be-tools-linux-"$sf_version"-"$linux4be_version" xLinux4BE

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
